title: Soccer on the Beach
text: {{name}} went to the beach with family. The sea was blue and the sand was soft. The wind was cool and the sky was clear. Birds flew high above the sea. {{name}} felt very happy on the trip. {{name}} brought a soccer ball. {{name}} played soccer with a cousin. The cousin's name was Lily. They kicked the ball on the warm sand. "Catch it!" {{name}} shouted to Lily. Lily kicked the ball very high. The ball went to the water. A wave came and pushed the ball. The ball went into the sea! "Oh no!" Lily cried. {{name}} ran fast to the water. {{name}} jumped and got the wet ball. "I have it!" {{name}} said. Lily clapped and laughed. They sat on the sand to rest. Then they made a goal with two hats. {{name}} kicked the ball into the goal. "Goal!" they shouted together. The family watched and clapped too. They played more games until the sun went down. {{name}} will go to the beach again next year.

questions.prompt: What did they make a goal with?

summary: 主角和家人去海边度假,与表亲在沙滩踢球,球被海浪冲进水里,主角跑去捡回湿球,两人用帽子做球门继续开心比赛,度过最棒的海滩日。
